title: Sound hunt
instructions: Ask your child to find five safe everyday sounds at home and name what made each one.

title: Same or different
instructions: Make two simple sounds, such as clap/tap. Ask whether they are the same or different.

title: Loud or soft
instructions: Make a soft tap and a normal clap. Ask which is louder.
note: Do not make startling or loud noises

title: Fast or slow
instructions: Clap three times quickly, then slowly. Ask your child to identify each.

title: Sound memory
instructions: Make a two-sound pattern and ask your child to copy it.
note: Increase to three sounds only if easy

title: Find three rhymes
instructions: Find three words that rhyme with cat.
note: Silly made-up rhyming sounds count too
